cohort: 99 nulliparous women with a single fetus in cephalic presentation and spontaneous labor onset at a gestational age of ≥37 weeks
finding: Ultrasound-measured fetal head station, using head-perineum distance and angle of progression, effectively predicted delivery mode and remaining labor time, with distinct descent patterns observed for spontaneous, instrumental, and cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: This study of nulliparous women found that ultrasound-measured fetal head descent patterns during spontaneous labor were similar to patterns based on clinical vaginal examinations, and fetal head station was associated with mode of delivery and remaining labor time.
